spans.s: ककार m. the sound क.
ककुत्स्थ m. N. of an ancient king.

काकुत्स्थ m. descendant of Kakutstha (E. of Daśaratha,
Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, etc.).
काकु॑द् f. the hollow of the mouth, palate.
क॑कुद n. (m.) the same.
ककुद्मन् a. high, lofty.

ककु॑द्मन्त् a. = prec. & seq.;
 m. mountain or buffalo.
ककुद्मिन् a. having a hump.
ककु॑न्मन्त् a. towering, lofty.

ककुभ॑ a. high, lofty, sublime, eminent. m. a kind of
goblin, a cert. musical mode.
ककुह॑ a. = prec. adj.

काकोल m. raven;
 n. a cert. poison or hell.
कक्षी॑वन्त् m. N. of a Ṛṣi.
1 क॑क्ष्य a. belonging to a thicket.

2 कक्ष्य॑ a. hidden, secret. f. आ girdle, cincture;
balance.

काक m. ई f. a crow;
 abstr. ˚ता f.
काका f. croaking (onom.).

काकतालीय a. unexpected, sudden, lit. like the crow
(killed by the) palm-fruit^1;
 n. & ˚वत् adv.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
काकपद n. a crow's foot.

काकपदमस्तशीर्षक an abusive word (lit.
foot, head, and skull of a crow)*.
काकलि f. a soft sweet sound or song.
काक˚ली f. a soft sweet sound or song.
काकाय् काका˚यते make kākā.
काकिणी f. a cert. small coin.
काकि˚नी f. a cert. small coin.
काकु f. wail, lamentation, emphatic speech.
काकोलूक m. pl. crows and owls.
